## Council question

What does the Atreides Carryall count toward?

## Why this needs a ruling

Quickstart v0.8 reserves Carryall for Atreides Fate and excludes it from the standard-token entry rule. The live Atreides sheet says it cannot be lost and triggers when a mine sends troops to reserves. Its relationship to token payout counts and the three-token victory point needs explicit wording.

## Answer needed

Confirm whether Carryall counts toward the number of tokens used for payout, the three-token limit, and the tech-token victory point.

## Provisional drafting approach

Distinguish each count explicitly in the rulebook instead of using one undefined phrase, "all tokens".

This is a research question, not an adopted ruling or a claim that Norbert has answered it. No answer has been supplied yet. Keep the affected rules provisional until Norbert or the council confirms them.

## Sources

[Live Atreides](https://dune.zone/factions/house-atreides); Quickstart v0.8, Tech Tokens and Arrakis Fiefdom.

Part of #1831. Record the confirmed answer, its date and a worked example here before closing. Norbert will share this link with the council; this ticket does not send them a message.
title: Dreamrules ruling: What does the Atreides Carryall count toward?
